labels.wageHint: Used to estimate pay in lieu of notice for monthly-paid workers.
labels.compensation: Pay in lieu if no notice is given

notes.rules: Under Kuwait's private-sector Labour Law (Law 6 of 2010, Art. 44) on an indefinite contract notice is 3 months for workers paid monthly and 1 month for other workers. Ending the contract without notice means paying compensation equal to pay for the notice period.
notes.disclaimer: Estimate only. Pay in lieu is shown as the monthly wage times the notice months, and your contract may set longer terms. Fixed-term contracts and probation follow different rules. Confirm with your employer or the Public Authority for Manpower.
